theorems.name: Submission.frt_ball_bound_of_finite_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (x : Euclidean N) (θ : ℝ≥0∞), θ ≠ ∞ → HasDensity n μ x θ → ∃ K j : ℕ, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1) → μ (closedBall x ρ) ≤ (K : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
